snippet.title: Finding your cast shadows accurately.
snippet.description:
Tap the link in my bio to start the drawing drills course. 

Ever wondered how to figure out exactly where a cast shadow should land?

You can use perspective to construct it!

The light and foot method uses two points: the position of your light source and its projected position on the ground, called the light’s foot.

Draw a line from the light source through a point on your object, then another from the light’s foot through that point’s ground position. Where those lines intersect determines where its shadow falls.

Repeat this for important points along the object to construct the cast shadow.

This drawing technique helps you create believable lighting without guessing.

Light follows geometric rules. Learn those rules, and you can construct shadows from imagination.

#howtodraw #drawingtutorial #drawinghowto #artlesson
